additional_info.subject: incorrect analysis
additional_info.body:
Dear SiD Team,
The analysis is incorrect. The display has no hardware damage; it appears to be a software problem. This problem occurred a few years ago. At that time, it helped to back up the outlet configuration in SCB beforehand, then delete it and reset it. Afterwards, use SSH to check whether the HMI is displaying the outlets again. Please carry out these steps and let us know whether it helped.
BR Domenico
